tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Search active (not expired) deals on Pechincha.ai, 10 per page by default (`limit` up to 25); with `query` the most relevant come first, without it the newest, unless `sort` says otherwise. Each result has price and old price in BRL, discount %, store, coupon code if any, publication date, the deal

tools.name: get_deal
tools.description: Full details of a deal: product photo, price and discount in BRL, store, coupon, purchase link, 30-day price history, product pros/cons, specs and FAQ. Markdown in Brazilian Portuguese.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: A product across stores: product photo, current offers with prices in BRL, lowest price, 30-day price stats, review summary, pros/cons, specs and FAQ. Markdown in Brazilian Portuguese.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Price history of a product, to judge whether a discount is real: min/avg/max in BRL, number of records and up to 30 dated prices. Says so when prices span fewer than 3 different days (not enough history to judge). Content in Brazilian Portuguese.

tools.name: check_product_url
tools.description: Check whether Pechincha.ai has an active deal for a product page URL from an online store. Returns the deal (price in BRL, discount, store, coupon, purchase link) and the lowest price across stores, or says there is none. Content in Brazilian Portuguese.

tools.name: list_store_coupons
tools.description: Active coupon codes of a store on Pechincha.ai. Content in Brazilian Portuguese.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Pechincha.ai categories as name (Brazilian Portuguese) and slug, for the category filter of search_deals.

tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: Stores on Pechincha.ai as name and slug, for search_deals and list_store_coupons. Without `query`, only the stores with deals in the last 7 days; there are 1000+ stores, so pass `query` to find any other by name.

tools.name: get_similar_deals
tools.description: Active deals similar to a deal (same kind of product, other brands, models and stores), to compare alternatives or find a cheaper one. Content in Brazilian Portuguese.

tools.name: list_deal_coupons
tools.description: Active coupon codes of the store selling a deal, to check whether one applies to it. Each coupon title states its rule (discount, eligible products or brands, minimum purchase) and valid_until is the end date the store reports: compare them with the deal's title and price before suggesting a code. C

tools.name: list_coupon_stores
tools.description: Stores with active coupon codes on Pechincha.ai, as name and slug. Get the codes with list_store_coupons.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: Pechincha.ai themes as name and slug, for the theme filter of search_deals: seasonal events (Black Friday, Dia das Crianças...), gift ideas and product niches. Pass `query` to filter.

tools.name: get_list
tools.description: A public Pechincha.ai list (https://pechincha.ai/lista/<slug>), such as a gift list someone shared: name, description, price range and its active deals, 10 per page by default (`limit` up to 25). Content in Brazilian Portuguese.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Buying guides and articles from the Pechincha.ai blog: title, summary, date and URL. Search in Portuguese with short terms, e.g. "air fryer"; without `query`, the newest posts. Content in Brazilian Portuguese.
